name: ASC
description: ASC is a super FAST Android decompiler front-end designed for Agents/Mobile Researchers.
one_liner: A very fast tool for peeking inside Android apps' compiled code, built for security researchers (and AI agents) doing mobile app analysis.
buyer: A mobile-security researcher or pentesting firm auditing Android apps for vulnerabilities.
business_use_cases: A mobile app security auditing firm uses it to speed up client APK audits, billing fewer hours per app.
A bug-bounty hunter specializing in Android apps uses its speed advantage to analyze more targets per week.

money_ideas.idea: Use it as an internal speed advantage inside a mobile-security consulting practice, billed as pentesting or audit services

steal_this: Not really a weekend consumer product. It's a specialist speed tool for people who already do Android reverse engineering for a living.
